import threading

class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []
        self.notes = {}
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.seq = 0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._max_seq = 0

    def begin(self, query):
        with self._lock:
            self.seq += 1
            current_seq = self.seq
            # Clear loading errors but keep existing rows until valid finish
            self.error = None
            return current_seq

    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        with self._lock:
            # Only the latest begun request can update rows, once
            if request_id != self.seq or self.loading:
                return False
            self.rows = rows
            self.loading = True
            self._max_seq = max(self._max_seq, request_id)
            return True

    @property
    def is_loading(self):
        with self._lock:
            return self.loading

    def copy_accepted_rows(self):
        with self._lock:
            return list(self.rows) if self.loading else []

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from view import View

def test_basic_flow():
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    assert v.is_loading == False
    assert v.error is None
    result = v.finish(id1, ["a", "b"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["a", "b"]
    assert v.is_loading == True

def test_stale_response():
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    id2 = v.begin("q2")  # newer request
    result = v.finish(id1, ["old"])  # stale - should fail
    assert result == False
    result = v.finish(id2, ["new"])  # latest - should succeed
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["new"]

def test_duplicate_finish():
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    result1 = v.finish(id1, ["first"])
    assert result1 == True
    result2 = v.finish(id1, ["second"])  # duplicate - should fail
    assert result2 == False
    assert v.rows == ["first"]

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = View()
    v.error = "old error"
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    assert v.error is None

def test_begin_keeps_rows():
    v = View()
    v.rows = ["existing"]
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    # rows should still be there until finish
    assert v.rows == ["existing"]

def test_finish_sets_loading():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    result = v.finish(1, ["row"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.is_loading == True

def test_copy_accepted_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, ["a", "b"])
    copied = v.copy_accepted_rows()
    assert copied == ["a", "b"]
    # Original should still be there
    assert v.rows == ["a", "b"]

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    v.notes["job1"] = "note1"
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(id1, [])
    # Notes should persist
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note1"

def test_monotonic_seq():
    v = View()
    ids = []
    for _ in range(5):
        ids.append(v.begin("q"))
    assert ids == list(range(1, 6))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_basic_flow()
    print("test_basic_flow passed")
    test_stale_response()
    print("test_stale_response passed")
    test_duplicate_finish()
    print("test_duplicate_finish passed")
    test_begin_clears_error()
    print("test_begin_clears_error passed")
    test_begin_keeps_rows()
    print("test_begin_keeps_rows passed")
    test_finish_sets_loading()
    print("test_finish_sets_loading passed")
    test_copy_accepted_rows()
    print("test_copy_accepted_rows passed")
    test_notes_preserved()
    print("test_notes_preserved passed")
    test_monotonic_seq()
    print("test_monotonic_seq passed")
    print("\nAll tests passed!")
